ages.trait: Iron/Elvish Age — ends at Hybrian crash
Age of Baoth — surveillance state, Demonic War
Lost Era — anarchy, Eris cult fabricated
Age of Strife — to be written

events.event: The Crash. Ancient Glorious Alliance carrying war survivors crashes in Formingar Ocean. Survivors: humans, demons, elves, dwarves, dragons. Species spread across Ge'or. Impact triggers body bags in [[The 157th Colony
MELKOR island forms around the wreckage.
Age 0 — The Lost Era. Post-crash chaos. Survivors cling to the crash site; first dispersal begins.
Age 1 — Age of Nomadism. Survivors live as wanderers. No permanent settlements.
Age 2 — Age of First Tribes. Tribal societies form. Species begin differentiating by region.
Age 3 — Age of First Empires. First civilizations rise. Elvengar founded on Kutten — the first great elven kingdom.
Age 4 — Dragon Tyranny. Dragons rule 90% of Ge'or. Intense territorial warfare brings them to near-extinction.
Age 5 — Dwarf Era. Dwarves dominate through underground megacities fueled by Romanium. Economic collapse when Romanium runs out.
Age 6 — Iron/Elvish Age. Post-Romanium collapse. Dwarven economy in ruins. Elvengar rises. Ends with the Hybrian crash at Pontus.
Hybrian Shadows arrive. Damaged vessel crashes in Pontus (eastern Erisdar). Shadows chose Pontus for its mountain-surrounded isolation. Begin hibernation.
Phase 1 of the Shadow Plan. First millennium: study Ge'or, create Homunculi, infiltrate institutions, build secret cult.
Phase 2 of the Shadow Plan. Build global influence network. Engineer wars. Manipulate historical figures.
Old Lumina Empire founded by the beastman Emperor Kaelor I. A great beastmen empire — will eventually control 70% of Lumina Continent, Cattos island, and parts of Tuba.
Masaaki Sytrenis born — "Sytrenis the Diplomat," the catmen hero who will end the catmen extermination and the Termopolas threat (see Sytrenis).
The Metrak Incident. At twenty-two, Masaaki Sytrenis and his party stop the waking [[The Metraks

Old Lumina Empire falls. Shadow operation: Luminous XII defeated by Goblin King (engineered). Brother Hoelio killed. Luminous XII commits suicide. Empire collapses. The beastmen — the empire's own people — slowly return to savagery, forgetting their old ways. Maomism rises among the survivors. Lumina enters a tribal dark age.
Phase 3 of the Shadow Plan. Target Baoth as pan-continental super-state. Infiltrate Baoth's upper echelons. Possess Goldenborn.
Kirivis receives the bright tablet. Begins 60 years of obsessive study.
Kirivis has an epiphany. Deciphers the tablet. Falls into deep depression. Spends 10 years planning, sending secret teams across Ge'or.
The Demonic War. Kirivis attacks Baoth without explanation. 45 years of war.
Baoth destroyed. Kirivis storms the dragon hall. Rulfred reveals himself as Shadow agent. Kirivis beheaded. Crowd cheers. Rulfred becomes king.
Nethra survives. Kirivis's adopted daughter, age 13, escapes.
Nethra's march. Gathers loyalists. Brother Maoth sacrificed holding the line. Nethra reaches Rulfred's throne room.
The Lyrical Forest prophecy. Lyrical Forest spirits give Nethra a modified Shadow device — "a gift from 3,000,000 years ago."
Nethra transformed. Device detonates in throne room. Nethra becomes a different type of Shadow. Baoth's ruins are final.
Ironcloak founded. Nethra secretly creates the order. Nethrian Revelation transcribed.
Erisian Church fabricated. Eris (homunculus) performs staged miracles. Gathers followers. Fakes deaths and resurrections.
Church Militant. Holy orders conquer lands. Force conversions. Pontificate of Eris founded as Shadow headquarters.
Crusades launched. Waves of holy war expand Church control.
Elvengar flourishes. The first great elven kingdom dominates Kutten. Elves are the dominant civilization.
The Great Divergence. Formingar Ocean reactor malfunctions. The Groom vortex forms. Elvengar destroyed.
The Silver Bride ring — formed from destroyed third moon — becomes Ge'or's defining celestial feature.
The Kutten Catastrophe. Toxic rains and poisoned air desertify Kutten. Elves flee in great diaspora.
Elven refugees found Luzia and Maemon on Merratodoni.
Erisian Empire founded. Kingdom of Shamaradan atoned by Eris. Renamed under Davos the Magnificent.
Kutten recolonization begins. Settlers from Erisdar and Demon Continent arrive.
Vennerian Trade Republic breaks from Erisian Empire. Independence purchased with wealth.
Northaxeland Crusades.
Great Elvish Persecution. Erisian church campaigns to eliminate elves. Shadow-engineered operation.
Anos Plutocracy founded. Kingdom of Tiphar collapses after Lima and Venner invade to rescue Princess Charlotte. Anos city breaks away.
Great Ascension of Trade. Maritime republics rise. Colonial networks expand.
Great Erisian Empire War. Kennberg vs Prassen-Albridge. 22 years. Stalemate. Imperial authority permanently weakened.
**[[Founding of the Enkrad Order
Volcano eruption triggers earthquake and tsunami — water floods the 157th Colony bunker, carrying the Black Agent (with [[Ichi Eisenheart
Gigas Tribe founded. Conquest of neighboring tribes on Lumina. First telepathic dog-god chosen. Gigaoism begins.
Marko organized. Erisdarian and Demon Continent settlers formalize the neutral trade hub. High Catmen merchant families rise to power.
Amelia family pulse rifle discovered. An ancestor finds a Pulse Rifle from the Glorious Alliance crash in a western Grimmel cave. The weapon is passed down through eleven generations.
Dwarven resurgence. New dwarven nations established: Coalsteel Kingdom, Diamonds Kingdom, Dwarvengor.
Homunculi Kingdom stabilized. Formerly warmongering, Kobre homunculi develop agriculture and diplomacy. Omipre (the Unnamed) is legendary founder.
Elven population stabilizes. Independent elvish states re-enter geopolitics. Elven goods drive tolerance.
**[[The Taberis War
Asatru Empire stabilizes after civil war. General Doma's successors consolidate the reduced empire.
Anos–Komme Agreement. After intense negotiations, Komme joins [[Anos Plutocracy
**[[The Minir Invasion
Hermes Kennensbach born.
Hermes becomes Emperor. Begins reform attempts. Fails. Empire continues to crack.
Current Gigas dog-god born. Telepathic canine, now 22 years old in 597 AGD.
**[[The Kentian Civil War
Mann Order invaded by Erilian Federation. Tiaboria captured. Refugees flee to Fractured State of Erislod, forming New Mann.
Xikxia taken over. Zakarutian queen's sister exiled. Raises army of 8,000. Marches on Xikxia. Declares independence.
Zakarutia rebuilds fleet. Archaic navy modernizing for reconquest.
The Twinning. The black agent enters two women of the Grimmel Republic — Eisenheart and Mortvagn bloodlines. Incubates.
Rex Pollo IV elected in Vennerian Trade Republic.
Hermes Kennensbach commissions world map. Age 40. Empire still cracking.
**The Protagonists born — [[Emrys
South Sun Empire emperor compromised. Eunuch homunculi installed in court.
Present day — Age 11 (Great Divergence). 248 sovereign nations. The Shadows prepare Armageddon.
Amelia born. Sole heir of the Amelia family, future keeper of the pulse rifle.
Mana born. Possesses mother's body for 3 years, then incarnates as Lucien's little sister, having given him a childhood first.
Aelis born. In the Moonfang Dominion on frozen Moon Wolf Island. Blonde, petite, born into a poor cult family. The prettiest are sacrificed to [[Cleton Island
Amelia's father dies. On his deathbed, gives four-year-old Amelia the pulse rifle — eleventh generation of the lightning bow.

shadow_plan_phases.activity: Infiltration — study, create homunculi, seed institutions
Fragmentation — global network, engineered wars, Lumina fall
Consolidation — Baoth as super-state. Failed. Church launched as backup.
Current — rebuilding after Baoth. Armageddon imminent.
